next.reason: 1985 GR4: 'When file-name-1 is specified explicitly, no other USE statement applies to file-name-1.' 2023 gives the same result from four rules: another USE naming the file is refused ('The same file-name shall not appear in more than one USE AFTER EXCEPTION statement within the same procedure division', §2023:14.9.49.3 SR8, as 1985 SR3 did); the file-name USE 'takes precedence over any USE statements specifying an INPUT, OUTPUT, I-O, or EXTEND phrase' (§2023:14.9.49.4 GR5); each mode USE runs 'except those files referenced by file-name-1 in another USE statement specifying the same condition' (§2023:14.9.49.4 GR6); and 'The first declarative that satisfies the selection criteria is executed and no other declaratives are executed' (§2023:14.9.49.4 GR3). Format 3 and GLOBAL selection are new syntax. Same.
